description.value:
Your Sympathetic Pawns can make steal essence unarmed attacks. These deal 1d8 spirit damage, are in the brawling group, and have the agile, finesse, spirit, and unarmed traits. A creature damaged by this attack becomes fatebound, linked to the pawn that damaged it.

Your pawns can latch on to another creature's spiritual essence, intertwining their fates. Once per round, whenever one of your Sympathetic Pawns loses Hit Points, the creature linked to it by the fatebound condition takes 1d6 spirit damage with a basic Will save against your class DC. This damage increases by 1d6 at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th levels.

Your Sympathetic Pawns gain the Lay Bare reaction.
